hazard bearer

  • CURIE: gmeow:hazardBearer
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hazardBearer
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/risk

The entity in which this hazard inheres. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): a disposition has exactly one bearer (gUFO inherence, asserted with GMEOW's own property — Principle 5). The same danger borne by two systems is two hazards.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Hazard -> gmeow:Entity; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hazardBearer from gmeow:Hazard to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Hazard, gmeow:Entity
